subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive / demo
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@atlasbank.com>, Atlas Bank - Procurement <procurement@atlasbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive / demo

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical deep-dive: 

Summary (one line): Atlas Bank is evaluating a hosted + dedicated hybrid for PII-sensitive inference (payments fraud scoring) with tight latency SLOs and a prioritized focus on auditability.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical deep-dive + demo to cover architecture, SLA targets, security posture, and sample throughput numbers. Two windows we have open next week:
- Tue 11/24 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu 11/26 13:00–14:15 PT

Please let me know which slot works for your team and who should attend from the Atlas side (prod/infra, security, procurement). We’ll include:
- Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) — model latency and perf sizing
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — rollout/pooled capacity and billing
- Markus Klein (Infra Eng) — deployment and network/peering details

Attachments: RWD-demo-brief.pdf (slides, 6 pages), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (starter MAP).

Primary asks:
1) Confirm preferred slot (Tue/Thu or propose alternatives).
2) Confirm attendee list and any specific technical items you want covered (e.g., SOC2 evidence, tail latency targets, KV-cache behavior).

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@atlasbank.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Bank - Procurement <procurement@atlasbank.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive / demo

Thanks, Aditya — good recap. Thu 11/26 13:00 PT works best for our group. Attendees from Atlas:
- Emma Liu (Product, will own the session)
- Victor Chen (Infra / SRE)
- Laila Mahmood (Security / Compliance)
- Procurement inbox (procurement@atlasbank.com) — procurement will join late or receive MAP for review

Items we want covered in the deep-dive:
- SOC 2 evidence and log retention options
- Latency tail (p95/p99) for 512B–2KB payloads and expected throughput per GPU
- Data residency and VPC/private deployment options

We reviewed the attached brief and MAP; procurement will follow up separately on contract terms. For now, please include Victor and Laila on the invite and add any pre-read you recommend.

Also: if you have a short recorded demo (5–7m) of the console routing/observability we can share with the procurement team ahead of the demo, that would be helpful.

Best,
Emma
Product Manager | Atlas Bank
emma.liu@atlasbank.com
